tools.name: sessions_list
tools.title: Claude Code sessions
tools.description: The user's Claude Code sessions on this computer, running and closed, the running ones first, then the newest: id, name (its -n or /rename, often with a Dashboard task number such as #3120), dir (the folder it started in), account, last (when it last changed, epoch seconds), task (the number in its name, or null), prompt (its last prompt, cut short), running and address (its window, when it runs). Use it for "which session did X" or to find a session to go back to: the user continues one from the launcher's Sessions, or with `nightdrive sessions resume ID`.

query.title: Search
query.description: Words that must all be in its name, folder or task number (#3120 or 3120)
